en: The image shows a postcard reproducing an early Christian/Byzantine style mosaic. It depicts three haloed figures: Christ in the center holding a book, with a cruciform halo behind his head, flanked by two saints or apostles on either side. The mosaic uses small tesserae in gold, red, blue, and earth tones, with a richly patterned arch and golden background above the figures.
